content: WhatsApp Messaging Guidelines prohibit 'unofficial clients, bulk messaging, auto-messaging, auto-dialing, or automation'; enforcement includes 'temporarily or permanently suspending an account' and 'preventing further activity in groups and/or communities'. ToS prohibits creating accounts 'through unauthorized or automated means' and reverse engineering; WhatsApp 'may modify, suspend, or terminate your access... anytime for any reason'. Official alternative is WhatsApp Business Cloud API. Meta shipped a Cloud API Groups API (Oct 2025) but it requires an Official Business Account, caps groups at 8 participants, allows only 1 Cloud API business per group, is unavailable to WhatsApp Business app numbers, and only creates NEW groups - it cannot post into pre-existing consumer groups. So the official path does not cover this use case.
